notes:
Snapshot of account and recent interactions:
- Company: mid-market customer success platform; chat-first product that routes to agents and automates replies. Highly focused on user privacy for transcripts.
- Business driver: reduce live-agent handle time by 30% while keeping escalate-rate < 10%.
- Initial ask: Hosted API for fast time-to-value, auto-fall back to Dedicated once traffic predictable.
- Performance ask: streaming with token-level latency SLOs (they quoted 150-200ms target for short-turn tokens during streaming). Tool calling (calendar lookups, ticket API calls) required with deterministic end-to-end latency.
- Security ask: must pass mid-market security checklist: SSO (SAML + SCIM at minimum), SOC2 Type II, audit logs + retention controls, ability to redact PII from request/response logs before retention, KMS integration for encryption at rest, explicit data residency options for EU customers.
- Quote from Head of Product during 3/02 demo: "We can accept occasional quality regressions but not spikes in tail latency — streaming has to feel instant to end-users."
- Demo notes: 2/25 discovery call; 3/02 hosted API demo with streaming + tool-calling flow; demo included sample tool chain (calendar + ticket search) and a mock fallback to smaller model. They liked streaming chunked tokens.
- Pricing discussion: asked for blended ARR-friendly price if we commit to Dedicated after 6 months. Wants a worksheet comparing Hosted per-token vs Dedicated committed capacity.
- Security review in progress: provided SOC2 report copy pending, asked for sample redaction rules and log retention UI screenshots. SIEM integration question (can we push audit logs to their Splunk instance?).
- POC plan: 48-hour POC with synthetic load to validate streaming latency SLOs (95/99p), and one week shadowing on low % production traffic if POC passes.
- Internal champions: Head of Product (Eva Lin), Eng Manager (Marcus Reed). Procurement contact: Finance lead Maria Ortiz.
- Risk: if Redwood cannot demonstrate PII redaction for logs or provide SAML/SCIM flows within 2 weeks, they will evaluate alternate vendors.
- CRM action items: send SSO integration doc + sample SAML metadata (Alicia), schedule POC perf test for 3/16, attach pricing worksheet v1, loop SE for perf script (Tom).
